capabilities: organize open tabs and custom groups in a collapsible vertical tree
assign custom accent colors and Lucide icons to tab groups
search and filter active tabs, groups, and paths in real time
rename groups and manage workspace organization via built-in modals
configure sidebar appearance, indent size, and compact view in settings
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; licensed under AGPLv3 with an explanation of its network-copyleft clause.
intentEvidence: replaces standard horizontal tab strips with a clean, responsive vertical sidebar hierarchy
problem: Obsidian's standard horizontal tab strip offers no hierarchy or grouping, making it hard to organize and navigate many open tabs.
summary: Tree-structured vertical tab manager that replaces Obsidian's horizontal tab strip with a collapsible sidebar of grouped, color-coded tabs.
